This is a white bowl, probably about 22-24 cm across, holding mixed greens, broccoli florets, and dark grapes or olives. The dark round items could be either. The salad looks like a moderate serving of about 180 g: roughly 60 g of greens, 90 g of broccoli, and 30 g of grapes or olives. Grapes would add about 20 kcal and olives about 40. The broccoli adds about 30 kcal and the greens about 10, so the total is roughly 80-100 kcal. I'll allow for some dressing and say 110 kcal.
